stance: Consumer sentiment is mixed. UMich-type readings stay weak (48.0 in October; 5y inflation expectations 3.5%). Conference Board rebounded to 91.7 (unconfirmed). Ifo rose to 90.6 in November (verified, 2 sources) from 90.1, in line with consensus, with gains in services and trade and a manufacturing dip. German momentum improves slowly while US consumer surveys diverge. Low conviction, neutral-to-bearish lean on US consumer.
